content: Bring the active M0001 implementation session up to the current distilled-session standard, remove superseded transcript-like detail, and make active-session end-state semantics explicit in the session tooling.

The S013 audit found durable implementation results mixed with routine skill-load chatter, a raw Nix command, local store identities, duplicate mirror wording, an invalidated release-pass claim, and superseded D0021 routing. The session held no source copy, attachment, build tree, dependency store, download, or raw log; only the W01 title and active-session end state had drifted.

Record revision 225c32d8f1d0e9e0e21021cd2b95a250b2f5083e distilled S013 from 25 events to 13 material facts, removed the false release-pass and obsolete routes, retained one assertion lesson, restored the current W01 title, preserved skill reload guidance in handoff, and set ended_at to null while the session remains active.

Content revision 98d37d5500071c15ecea137252571a9b18ac3b6a makes new sessions active with ended_at null and the current summary shape, rejects active sessions with an end time and terminal sessions without one, and adds an end-to-end scaffolder fixture. Skill discovery, catalog, routing, and task-based loading were unchanged.

Final gates passed: the repository record graph contains 18 sessions, 145 events, and 163 Markdown files; validator/scaffolder self-tests passed 58/58; skill routing passed 23/23; git diff --check and independent review found no remaining blocker. Temporary scaffold trees were removed automatically and no build, download, source copy, or raw log remains.
